name: Moonshine Molotov
description: Throw a bottle of moonshine that ignites the impacted area on fire and sends out burning oil.

subskills.name: Moonshine Molotov
subskills.description: Core of the Moonshine Molotov subtree.

subskills.name: Extra Gasoline
subskills.description: Increased damage.

subskills.name: Double Bourbon
subskills.description: Chance to throw an additional molotov.

subskills.name: Wider Flames
subskills.description: Increases flame radius.

subskills.name: Scorching Collision
subskills.description: Direct hits with the molotov breaks monsters fire resistances.

subskills.name: Gas Leak
subskills.description: Molotovs leave a small trail of fire as they travel.

subskills.name: Oil Spilled Flask
subskills.description: Chance for molotovs to spill oil around them.

subskills.name: Burn The Demons
subskills.description: Inflicts burning on hit.

subskills.name: Redeeming Flames
subskills.description: Increases the amount of spills from moonshine molotov.

subskills.name: Bottle Flip
subskills.description: Molotovs now bounce once when they hit the ground redirecting them towards the closest enemy.

subskills.name: Resilient Liquid
subskills.description: Increases the duration of flames.

subskills.name: Heated Melting Point
subskills.description: Moonshine molotovs now ignite into blue flames increasing its damage significantly.

subskills.name: Set The World On Fire!
subskills.description: Throw multiple molotovs around you for a short period setting the world ablaze. Moonshine molotov now has a cooldown.

subskills.name: Flaming Tar
subskills.description: Direct hits cause enemies to leave a trail of fire wherever they go damaging other nearby enemies dealing increased damage and inflicting burning.

subskills.name: Blazing Trail of Flames
subskills.description: Molotov now bounces additional times from the ground spilling small flames around.

name: Pipe Bombs
description: Throw a barrage of handcrafted pipe bombs dealing area of effect fire damage.

subskills.name: Pipe Bombs
subskills.description: Core of the Pipe Bombs subtree.

subskills.name: Stacked Bag
subskills.description: Throw additional bombs.

subskills.name: Lowered Weight
subskills.description: Increases the projectile speed of pipe bombs.

subskills.name: TNT Mass
subskills.description: Increases the size and explosion area of effect radius of pipe bombs.

subskills.name: Bomberman
subskills.description: Increases faster cast rate when using pipe bombs.

subskills.name: Splitting Explosive
subskills.description: Chance on hit to split into multiple pipe bombs.

subskills.name: Wounding Blast
subskills.description: Inflicts bleeding on hit.

subskills.name: Salt Covering
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to bleeding targets.

subskills.name: Blasting Powder
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by pipe bombs.

subskills.name: Anti Fatigue
subskills.description: Decreases the mana cost of pipe bombs.

subskills.name: Upwards Pressure
subskills.description: Chance on hit to knock up monsters dealing additional damage.

subskills.name: Fiery Infusion
subskills.description: Pipe bombs now leave burning flames on the ground with increased damage and area of effect radius.

subskills.name: Disorienting Blast
subskills.description: Knock monsters back with massive power causing them to take additional damage and be stunned when hitting terrain.

subskills.name: Eat This!
subskills.description: Throw a single pipe bomb with force unleashing multiple pipe bombs in a circle around the impact point.

subskills.name: Colossal Explosive
subskills.description: Throw a giant pipe bomb that bounces multiple times dealing increased damage. Each bounce it shrinks in size and deals less damage until it vanishes.

name: Tire Fire
description: Throw a truck tire that deals fire damage on hit.

subskills.name: Tire Fire
subskills.description: Core of the Tire Fire subtree.

subskills.name: Tire Density
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by tire fire.

subskills.name: Increased Stock
subskills.description: Increases the projectile speed of tire fire.

subskills.name: Scaling Up
subskills.description: Increases the size of tires.

subskills.name: Hard Hitter
subskills.description: Knocks monsters back with increased damage.

subskills.name: Bouncy Tire
subskills.description: Tires now bounce over gaps and short terrain dealing a damaging area of effect pulse when landing.

subskills.name: Flaming Tire
subskills.description: Inflicts burning on hit.

subskills.name: Overheated
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to burning targets.

subskills.name: The Machinist
subskills.description: Increases faster cast rate when casting tire fire.

subskills.name: Oily Tire
subskills.description: Tire now leaves a trail of oil behind with increased radius.

subskills.name: Impact Angle
subskills.description: Tires now bounce off of high terrain and environment increasing its damage per impact.

subskills.name: Monster Truck Tire
subskills.description: Now sends out a big monster truck tire stunning and knocking monsters up on hit dealing increased damage. Tire fire now has a cooldown.

subskills.name: Mini Tires
subskills.description: Now send out multiple smaller tires in an arc.

subskills.name: Donuts
subskills.description: Tires now spiral outwards inflicting fire break on hit.

subskills.name: Loose Tire
subskills.description: Send out a bouncing tire dealing increased area of effect damage every time it lands.

name: Oil Spill
description: Spill oil on the ground slowing and lowering monster attack rating. Oil also ignites into flames when coming in contact with Moonshine Molotov dealing additional burning damage.

name: Hillbilly Rage
description: Temporarily increases your fire skill damage.

name: Spontaneous Combustion
description: When igniting oil in flames, also make the monsters combust dealing area of effect fire damage around them.

name: Moonshine Madness
description: Increases your attack rating and movement speed.

name: Pickup Raid
description: Call your hillbilly friends to siege your opponents in a pickup truck dealing fire damage.

subskills.name: Pickup Raid
subskills.description: Core of the Pickup Raid subtree.

subskills.name: Ignition
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by pickup raid.

subskills.name: Oil Leak
subskills.description: All raid participants leak oil on the ground.

subskills.name: Napalm Filling
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to burning targets.

subskills.name: V12 Engine
subskills.description: Increases travel speed of all raid members.

subskills.name: Shattering Shells
subskills.description: Buckshots from the motorcycle rider now inflict fire break on hit.

subskills.name: Speed Dial
subskills.description: Decreases the cooldown of pickup raid.

subskills.name: Billy & Little Bob
subskills.description: Adds a motorcycle rider to the pickup raid firing buckshots.

subskills.name: Double Barrel
subskills.description: Pickup truck now fires additional projectiles.

subskills.name: Moonshine Miles
subskills.description: Adds a wooden airplane to the pickup raid dropping bombs dealing area of effect damage.

subskills.name: Crackling Fire
subskills.description: Bombs dropped by the wooden airplane now inflict burning on hit.

subskills.name: Suicide Squad
subskills.description: The raid now moves towards target location exploding into multiple big explosions and truck tires rolling into all directions.

subskills.name: Freedom Convoy
subskills.description: Now send multiple pickup trucks.

subskills.name: Drunken Air Raid
subskills.description: Now only send a raid of planes that fire projectiles and drop bombs.

subskills.name: Tarethiel MC
subskills.description: Now only send motorcycle riders firing buckshot inflicting burning on hit.

name: Chainsaw Slash
description: Perform an area of effect attack attaching a spinning chainsaw on monsters for a short period of time.

subskills.name: Chainsaw Slash
subskills.description: Core of the Chainsaw Slash subtree.

subskills.name: Wider Chain
subskills.description: Increases the attack area of effect radius of chainslaw slash.

subskills.name: Accelerated Chain
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by chainsaw slash.

subskills.name: Double The Logging
subskills.description: Chance to attach an additional chainsaw on hit.

subskills.name: Rupturing Slash
subskills.description: Chance on inflict bleeding on hit.

subskills.name: Chaining Uppercut
subskills.description: Chance on hit to send monsters airborne dealing increased area of effect damage when landing.

subskills.name: The Motor Goes BRRRRR!
subskills.description: Increases chainsaw slash attack speed while wielding a chainsaw.

subskills.name: Bigger Saw
subskills.description: Increases the area of effect radius and size of rotating chainsaws.

subskills.name: Strengthened Bloodlust
subskills.description: Increases rotating chainsaw damage and size based on your total strength.

subskills.name: Malfunctioning Chainsaw
subskills.description: Chainsaws explode after expiring dealing additional damage and stunning nearby enemies.

subskills.name: Bloody Carnage
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to bleeding enemies.

subskills.name: Giant Slash
subskills.description: Every 4th attack unleashes a giant slash dealing increased damage and inflicting armor break.

subskills.name: Woodcutter´s Madness
subskills.description: Every 3rd hit unleashes a spinning attack with increased radius and dealing increased damage.

subskills.name: Gas To The Chainsaws
subskills.description: Each target can only have one chainsaw attached to them but striking them again causes it to reset its duration, growing in size and dealing additional damage up to 10 times.

subskills.name: Sawing Momentum
subskills.description: Enemies killed while a chainsaw is attached to them release the chainsaws outwards. If they hit a new target, they attach themselves to them instead.

name: Loggers Endurance
description: Increases your life and life replenish.

name: Chainsaw Massacre
description: Violently spin your chainsaw dealing damage to monsters around you. Going the full distance unleashes a whirl attack with increased damage and area of effect.

subskills.name: Chainsaw Massacre
subskills.description: Core of the Chainsaw Massacre subtree.

subskills.name: Wielding The Saw
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by chainsaw massacre while you are wielding a chainsaw.

subskills.name: Saw Through The Woods
subskills.description: Increases the area of effect radius of chainsaw massacre.

subskills.name: Sawing Execution
subskills.description: Chainsaw massacre now executes targets below a certain percentage of life.

subskills.name: Final Stand
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt by chainsaw massacre's ending whirl.

subskills.name: Optimal Working Hours
subskills.description: Decreases duration but increases damage dealt each second spent spinning.

subskills.name: Overtime
subskills.description: Increases the duration of chainsaw massacre.

subskills.name: Critical Wounding
subskills.description: Inflicts bleeding on hit.

subskills.name: Resilient Sustain
subskills.description: Increases your life steal and mana steal when using chainsaw massacre.

subskills.name: Logging Machine
subskills.description: Increases spinning speed of chainsaw massacre.

subskills.name: Calling in Sick
subskills.description: Decreases the duration of chainsaw massacre.

subskills.name: Logger´s Lil Helpers
subskills.description: Additionally summons multiple chainsaws that spin around you at different speeds while chainsaw massacre is active.

subskills.name: Raging Sawblades
subskills.description: Perform the ending whirl frequently while spinning.

subskills.name: Standstill Focus
subskills.description: Spin in place dealing increased damage. Each kill increases the area of effect radius of chainsaw massacre.

subskills.name: Woodcutter´s Expertise
subskills.description: Gain absolute control of the spinning dealing increased damage and inflict bleeding on hit.

name: Experienced Logger
description: Increases your chance for critical strike and critical strike damage.

name: Revved Up
description: Temporarily increases your attack speed and damage.

name: Rogue Chainsaw
description: Throw a chainsaw on the ground spinning and dealing increased damage and additional arcane damage to monsters struck.

subskills.name: Rogue Chainsaw
subskills.description: Core of the Rogue Chainsaw subtree.

subskills.name: Overheating Engine
subskills.description: Increases the spinning speed of rogue chainsaws.

subskills.name: Ripping Impact
subskills.description: Chance to inflict bleeding on hit.

subskills.name: Handling Skills
subskills.description: Increases the cast rate of rogue chainsaw while wielding a chainsaw.

subskills.name: Rough Chains
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by rogue chainsaw.

subskills.name: Engine Gone Wild
subskills.description: When expiring, the chainsaws launch into the direction they are facing, dealing additional damage and bouncing off of terrain.

subskills.name: Chaining Chainsaws
subskills.description: Launched chainsaws have a chance to chain when they first hit an enemy.

subskills.name: Empty The Workbag
subskills.description: Chance on cast to throw additional rogue chainsaw.

subskills.name: Ruthless Chainsaws
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to bleeding targets.

subskills.name: Consumed Rupture
subskills.description: When hitting a bleeding monster, consume the bleeding debuff and unleash an explosion of blood scaling with the bleeding damage.

subskills.name: Full Gas Tank
subskills.description: Increases the duration of rogue chainsaws.

subskills.name: Slice Em Up!
subskills.description: Chainsaws now slowly travel forward with increased size and damage.

subskills.name: Shredding Squad
subskills.description: Launch multiple rogue chainsaws in an arc instead of throwing them on the ground.

subskills.name: Homing Chainsaws
subskills.description: Rogue chainsaws now home towards the closest monster.

subskills.name: Circle of Cutting
subskills.description: Throw multiple rogue chainsaws in a circle around you, traveling back to you upon landing.

name: Chainsaw Mastery
description: Increases your damage and attack rating when using a chainsaw.

name: Tree Trunk Triumph
description: Summon a massive tree and cut it down on nearby monsters dealing increased damage and additional arcane damage.

subskills.name: Tree Trunk Triumph
subskills.description: Core of the Tree Trunk Triumph subtree.

subskills.name: Splinters
subskills.description: Trunks have a chance to explode into multiple splinters inflicting monsters hit with bleeding for a portion of the damage.

subskills.name: Treefall
subskills.description: Chance to stun on hit.

subskills.name: Heavy Trunk
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to stunned targets.

subskills.name: Sequoia
subskills.description: Increases the size of tree trunks.

subskills.name: Sticking Splinters
subskills.description: Splinters stick to monsters on hit dealing damage over time.

subskills.name: Skillfull Fall
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by tree trunk triumph.

subskills.name: Sudden Treefall

subskills.name: Maiming Collision
subskills.description: Inflicts arcane break on hit.

subskills.name: Heavy Fall
subskills.description: Chance on hit to unleash a shockwave in the falling direction, dealing additional damage.

subskills.name: Clear The Way

subskills.description: Multiple trunks fall from the sky on target location, falling towards the nearest monster. Tree trunk triumph now has a cooldown.
